options.reason: its makespan upper bound 986334.72 s exceeds the 20 minutes a run may take locally

lost.reason: its makespan upper bound 986334.72 s exceeds the 20 minutes a run may take locally

full.reason: no measured candidate is eligible: measure one listed under unmeasured, or declare the accounts of the ones measured

unmeasured.measureWith: a rehearsal on kaggle:daprosero that runs the timing probe there (generate-job --accelerator-kind cpu, submit --smoke, fetch --smoke) and appends its own row

rules.makespan: the stage's units (one fold x seed pair, every arm on the same machine) packed onto the option's slots (processes locally, sessions x processes per account), each slot paying its setup once per session, from each candidate's own rows at its fastest measured setting
rules.order: smallest makespan upper bound, then fewest accelerator hours, then CPU, then local

unmeasuredMeans: no row of that candidate: it is never extrapolated from another host or device
